snippet.title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend | Basketball Career Simulator Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator for PC where RPG decisions, Live 2D Match Center gameplay and player development shape a living basketball world.

WISHLIST AND REQUEST PLAYTEST ACCESS ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968700/Hoop_Dynasty_Rise_of_a_Legend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=main_gameplay_trailer&utm_content=official_main_gameplay

Watch the official main gameplay trailer and follow the complete game-day loop: advance through a living career, enter the Locker Room, face RPG choices, control the action in Match Center, make halftime decisions, develop your player and return to a world where every season leaves a mark.

Choose your path through College, International and Pro basketball. Earn your role. Navigate contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, national teams, records and awards while the world keeps evolving around your career.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Living Basketball Career
0:13 Game Day and Match Center
0:26 Halftime RPG Decisions
0:41 Final Buzzer and Result
0:51 Player Development and Legacy

EXPLORE THE BASKETBALL CAREER GAME:
https://hoopdynasty.info/game.html

HOW THE CAREER SIMULATION WORKS:
https://hoopdynasty.info/stories/basketball-career-simulation.html

JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
https://discord.com/invite/sEmzpd8X3J

Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is an original single-player basketball career management game. All teams, players, leagues, awards, logos, names, histories and statistics depicted are fictional.

#HoopDynasty #BasketballGame #CareerMode
